description: Find free and busy time in a date range — use for "when am I free?", "am I available Tuesday afternoon?" or finding a slot for a new meeting. Searches all calendars unless one is given. Events marked TRANSPARENT (does not block time) and cancelled events are ignored; recurring events are expanded.

calendar_url.description: Optional: restrict to one calendar. Omit to consider every calendar, which is usually what "am I free" means.

include_event_details.description: Optional: also list the events behind each busy block, with titles. Off by default — the answer to "when am I free" is the slots, not the meetings.

time_range_end.description: End of the window to examine (ISO 8601). Required.

time_range_start.description: Start of the window to examine (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-05-25T00:00:00Z). Required.

name: freebusy_query
